items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: You were with that band? Yeah. See me on the picture?

ctx.x: Yeah, he went to Switzerland to be a banker. Oh. That's the last letter I got from him. He was going, he was going to Switzerland to learn how to be a banker. Oh, yeah. Well, they have plenty of money there. Oh, you know David Griffiths? No. But he's from Europe. Oh, yeah. Mm-hmm. England? Yeah, he's from England. Yeah. You from England? No, it's from England. I'm serious. Mm-hmm.

Yeah. Well. Oh, yeah. I saw that picture of, uh, Anker's band up there. Who? Anker's band, yeah. Yeah, Raymond Anker's band up there. Mm-hmm. Want to get that? We can talk about it for a minute. You were with that band? Yeah. See me on the picture? I see ya. Mm-hmm. Yeah.
Put this down. Yeah, you can take it down.
